blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse for Reinsurance & Commercial Lines — trusted data at decision speed — pipelines, lakehouse and governance that stand up to audit applied to the reinsurance & commercial lines operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Reinsurance and specialty commercial books trade in complexity: treaty structures, cat exposure, bordereaux reconciliation and capital optimization. The data flows between cedants, reinsurers and brokers are still largely spreadsheets — which is why settlement cycles and model confidence suffer.

items: Ceded premium/loss bordereaux arrive in formats and qualities; reconciliation consumes analysts and hides data quality issues.
Retro programs and cat capacity buying are combinatorial; incumbent methods stop early.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Data Monetization & Analytics Products, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Bordereaux intake/reconciliation, Treaty settlement, Retro/capacity optimization) on Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — Solvency II / RBC among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Lakehouse the right way — Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Decisions at event speed — sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Metrics into management — one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.
format-normalized intake with auto-reconciliation and quality scoring (70%+ auto-reconciled)
